import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { __FORGE_COMPONENT__ } from '../src/domain/__FORGE_COMPONENT_FILE__.ts';

describe('__FORGE_COMPONENT__', () => {
  it.each(['', '   '])('rejects an empty identity: %j', id => {
    expect(() => __FORGE_COMPONENT__.create(id)).toThrow('Identity is required');
  });
  it('retains a valid identity', () => {
    expect(__FORGE_COMPONENT__.create('item-1').id).toBe('item-1');
  });
});
